channelMetadataRenderer.description:
For business / promotional inquiries, please contact through this email: enayetchowdhurybusiness@gmail.com 

This channel is all about intellectual entertainment. I will upload and stream video contents and live sessions respectively which can add value to your life, intellectually enrich you and create a perspective.

If I am a stranger to you, let me introduce myself. I am Md Enayet Chowdhury, currently working as a lecturer at the Institute of Water and Flood Management (IWFM), Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET), Dhaka, Bangladesh. I love to write on the technical issues of engineering in an easily understandable way. I am also a researcher. I love to research my field from the core of my heart. You can check out my recent publications in my Google Scholar and ResearchGate profile.
